newsitem.title: JAPAN: LME prices steady in Asia after overnight slide.
newsitem.headline: LME prices steady in Asia after overnight slide.

text.p: London Metal Exchange prices held mostly steady in Asian trade on Wednesday after slumping overnight in an apparent correction of recent rallies, traders said.
Traders noted Japanese aluminium buying after prices slid in London on Tuesday to their lowest levels in 3-1/2 weeks.
One trader attributed the market's losses to chart-driven fund liquidation, adding that further probing of the downside may be in order before prices resume their upward climb.
At 0745 GMT, LME benchmark three-month copper was quoted at $2,327/32 a tonne, barely firmer from $2,325/30 at 1900 GMT on Tuesday. Copper ended Tuesday's afternoon kerb at $2,333, off $12.
Aluminium was quoted at $1,633/37 a tonne, compared with $1,631/33 at 1900 GMT on Tuesday and $1,642 at the close of Tuesday's afternoon kerb.
